title: Book Review: The God of Small Things by Arundhati Roy ★★☆☆☆
author: Terence Eden
summary: I did not care for this one bit. I found it cloying, infantilising, and far too circuitous. It starts off as a bit of an overwritten melodrama, where every phrase is a delicious flower waiting to bloom, but ends up being a over-sugared mess with a rotten heart.
